description: This file defines the SecurityPolicyInterface within the Twig Sandbox namespace, specifying methods that security policy classes must implement to ensure safe template execution.

classes.name: SecurityPolicyInterface
classes.description: Interface that all security policy classes must implement in Twig Sandbox, declaring methods for security checks on tags, filters, functions, method calls, and property access.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Method to verify security on tags, filters, and functions used in Twig templates.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Method to check if a particular method call on an object is allowed.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Method to check if access to a property on an object is permitted.
